verdict: Realty Income grew revenue 10% to $1.6B on rent and a fast-growing loan book, and net income available to common stockholders rose to $404M.

kpis.note: available to common, vs $0.35 a year ago

segments.name: Rental revenue
segments.note: Rent (including client reimbursements) from 15,536 properties — up 7%, the core REIT income.

segments.name: Interest & dividends on loans
segments.note: Interest and dividend income on loans and preferred equity investments — up 106% as the loan book grew.

segments.name: Interest on financing receivables
segments.note: Interest income on financing receivables — roughly flat.

otherDetail: Other is a net -$242M: interest expense of $334M, less a $114M gain on sales of real estate, $6M of other income, $3M of equity earnings and a $3M foreign-currency/derivative loss, and less $28M of net income attributable to noncontrolling interests — so the bottom line is net income available to common stockholders ($404M). Interest expense is shown here, not in operating expenses, per the REIT presentation in the task notes.
footerNote: Realty Income is a REIT: revenue is mostly rent, property operating expenses are cost of revenue, and depreciation, G&A and impairments are operating expenses. Amounts are rounded to $M from the release's thousands (total revenue $1,621.6M, net income $432.1M in total, $403.9M available to common stockholders); one $1M rounding adjustment is in merger/transaction costs. AFFO and FFO are non-GAAP REIT measures.
oneTimers: Provisions for impairment of real estate were $112M and credit-loss provisions $14M in the quarter.
Gain on sales of real estate was $114M, largely offsetting the impairments.
follow100Note: Kept as profit is net income available to common stockholders; total net income was $432M before $28M for noncontrolling interests (counted in other above).

takeaways.title: Revenue grew on rent and loans
takeaways.text: Total revenue rose to $1,622M — rent up 7% and loan and preferred-equity interest income more than doubling to $105M.

takeaways.title: AFFO per share up 4%
takeaways.text: AFFO — the REIT cash-earnings measure — was $1.12 per share, and Realty Income raised 2026 AFFO guidance to $4.45–$4.46.

takeaways.title: Portfolio stayed full
takeaways.text: Occupancy was 98.8% across 15,536 properties, with a 103.5% rent recapture rate on re-leased properties.
